systems.name: 4.1 Base Core & Frag System
systems.notes: Define 3×3 base cores for each agent. Detect when all core cells are occupied by opponent.
tasks: Mark base core positions for Agent A and B
Each tick, check if all 9 cells of a core are enemy colour
On defeat, increment opponent frags, trigger OS_REBOOT

systems.name: 4.2 Respawn (OS_REBOOT)
systems.notes: Clear defeated base, place new base far from enemy, reset fog, show notification.
tasks: Clear defeated agent's base core cells
Find random location at least 20% arena width from any enemy cell
Reset that agent's fog masks completely

systems.name: 4.3 System Purge (Overpopulation)
systems.notes: When occupied cells > 75%, reset the entire grid and both bases.
tasks: Reset both base cores to original positions
